maskCoordinates: Relative to base-cropped.png. Half-open rectangles and inclusive row spans.

face.note: Face plate and its amber visor move as one rigid pixel cluster. Hood stays fixed.

shoulders.note: Only coral upper-sleeve shoulder caps. Straps, forearms, hands, chest and all equipment remain fixed.

pixelMethod: Copy original selected pixels upward exactly one native pixel; locally expose the next row at vacated boundaries. Do not interpolate, regenerate, recolor or scale. Exclude straps and equipment from shoulder destinations.
scope: K4 only. Four deterministic keys, 1.5-second loop proposal. Other seven monsters untouched. No attack, walking or Unity integration.
